description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the "Number of" (with the remainder of the label obscured) and "Majority voting accuracy." The x-axis is labeled "Number of" followed by an obscured gray box, and uses a base-2 logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$, with tick marks at every power of 2 ($2^0$, $2^1$, $2^2$, $2^3$, $2^4$, $2^5$, $2^6$, $2^7$, $2^8$). The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks from 0.3 to 0.6 at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four lines displaying upward trends. A dark blue solid line with circular markers starts at $2^0$ with a value of approximately 0.43, increases to roughly 0.49 at $2^2$, 0.57 at $2^4$, 0.60 at $2^6$, and ends at $2^8$ with a value of approximately 0.61. A dark green dotted line with triangular markers begins at $2^0$ at approximately 0.43, remains flat to $2^1$ at 0.43, then increases to roughly 0.54 at $2^3$, 0.59 at $2^5$, and ends at $2^7$ with a value of approximately 0.61. A light blue solid line with circular markers starts at $2^0$ with a value of approximately 0.25, increases to roughly 0.30 at $2^2$, 0.39 at $2^4$, 0.42 at $2^6$, and ends at $2^8$ with a value of approximately 0.43. Finally, a light green dotted line with triangular markers starts at $2^0$ at approximately 0.25, remains flat to $2^1$ at 0.25, then increases to roughly 0.36 at $2^3$, 0.41 at $2^5$, and ends at $2^7$ with a value of approximately 0.43.
